text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The smell and sound of the gouged earth. 
The temperature and sharpness of the wind 
cutting through me. The sheer obsession 
for victory closing in on me...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Shake it off, leave it behind, and run, 
run, run, run...!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
That moment when there was no one left in 
front of me...!
choice_data_list: There's still a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
That moment when there was no one left in 
front of me...!
choice_data_list: There's still a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it was the absolute freest I've ever 
felt!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, my legs and my heart won't stop 
aching. ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. I'm gonna go run for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, don't try to stop me, okay? Not that 
I'd stop even if you tried!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I hurried after Mr. C.B., I resolved to 
support her so that she could run her own 
way next time as well.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right. I'm sure the world is 
much bigger out there.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
But if you only ever look ahead, you'll 
run out of breath. You might even miss out 
on the fun things along the way.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
So――just for now, let's surrender 
ourselves to these racing heartbeats♪
